verdict: changes_requested — 1 MAJOR (ui.library.tag_category.type = 类型 merges the English Kind/Type distinction the sidecar explicitly keeps apart, colliding with ui.library.sort.kind = 类型 and ui.canvas.files.kind = 类型), 1 MINOR (ui.library.kind.spreadsheet = 表格 where the corpus says 电子表格), 1 NIT on the English metadata only. All 20 keys are mechanically sound: placeholders none/none, key sets equal, no invisible or bidi characters, every badge inside the ~12 width budget, and all five hash bindings match byte-for-byte. 18 of 20 keys are clean as written.

findings.problem: The corpus's settled Chinese rendering of "Kind" is 类型 (ui.library.sort.kind = 类型; ui.canvas.files.kind = 类型), and the English keeps the tag group deliberately apart from that sort key — "Type" against "Kind" — with the sidecar instructing it outright: "Keep it distinct from the sort option 'Kind'." Rendering the tag heading as 类型 collapses that distinction on one screen: the Library sort control can read 类型 (sorting by kind) while the filter rail heads a tag group 类型 (tags of type `type`), so one string carries two meanings the source separates. 类型 is the right word for "Kind"; it is the wrong word for this key precisely because the locale has already spent it — the glossary binds one rendered word per term, and 类型 is bound to Kind.
findings.recommendation: 种类 — distinct from the corpus's 类型 for "Kind", and the ordinary word for a variety/type when naming a taxonomy group. 类别 is NOT available: ui.library.filter.categories = 类别 already carries "Categories" in the same rail. 分类 is a weaker second option if 种类 reads too broad above tag rows.

src/i18n/catalogues/en/ui.library.context.json: ui.library.tag_category.type.note = "LEGACY tag group id kept by the UI's ordering list; current core ids are format/status, so this is rare. Keep it distinct from the sort option 'Kind'."

i18n/glossary.md (manager byte-copy), line 1 and lines 3-4: "Glossary — one term, one decision, for every locale" / "Translation invariant per term: the SAME rendered word in every locale unless a row says otherwise." — 类型 is this corpus's settled rendering of the term Kind (sort.kind, canvas files.kind); spending the same string on the different English term Type breaks that binding instead of applying it.

findings.problem: Defensible rather than wrong: 表格 matches the legacy rail label ui.library.category.spreadsheets = 表格, and 表格 is a household name for a spreadsheet in Chinese (WPS 表格). The cost is precision and an internal split. The English says Spreadsheet, not Table, and 表格 in this same catalogue is also the plain-table word (ui.canvas.wysiwyg_markdown_editor.insert_table = 插入表格), so the badge is the one place the file kind can be read as "table". Meanwhile the rest of the product says 电子表格 for exactly this file kind, including inside the same namespace: ui.library.preview.sheet_unreadable = 无法读取此电子表格。 Width is not the obstacle — 电子表格 is 4 characters / 8 cells against the ~12 badge budget.
findings.recommendation: 电子表格 for the badge, aligning it with ui.canvas.files.spreadsheets, ui.canvas.file_rows.spreadsheets and this namespace's own preview error. If the rail's legacy ui.library.category.spreadsheets = 表格 is preferred instead, keep 表格 and accept the split — it does not gate on its own.
